en: Yeah.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: So you could ask GPT.

speaker: Unknown
en: And now you're going to figure out, OK, you get good at looking at the responses and going,
zh: 而现在你要弄清楚，好的，你擅长查看回复并接着说，

speaker: Unknown
en: Thanks for watching!

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, hey, you know, you didn't just start by being lazy and asking me.
zh: 你知道，嘿，你知道，你并没有只是因为懒惰就一上来就问我。

speaker: Unknown
en: You did your research, you're unsatisfied with the answer, and here's why.
zh: 你做了你的研究，你对答案不满意，这就是原因。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, that's a much better way to frame asking for help.
zh: 你知道，这是一个更好的来构建寻求帮助的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, that part of being unsatisfied with the answer, that for me is very crucial.
zh: 是的，对答案不满意的那一部分，对我来说非常关键。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because you could take an answer and be like, well, this isn't the truth.

speaker: Unknown
en: This is good enough.
zh: 这已经足够好了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or you think and you're like, well, this doesn't really make sense based on what I know or based on conversations I've had.
zh: 或者你会想，然后说，好吧，根据我所知道的或根据我参与过的对话，这真的讲不通。

speaker: Unknown
en: Among the skills that I think we get better at is really questioning, you know.
zh: 我认为我们会变得更好的技能之一就是真正的质疑，你知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, it's not enough to go, oh, well, this is the answer.
zh: 你知道，只是说哦，好吧，这就是答案，是不够的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like, well, why is that the answer?
zh: 就像是，好吧，为什么那是答案？

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, and you keep kind of going backwards, right?

speaker: Unknown
en: You're digging backwards into really a fundamental understanding.

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you build that fundamental understanding back, you actually really can understand the problem space you're in and be much more effective.

speaker: Unknown
en: Is it a news tabloid or is it actually truthful information?

speaker: Unknown
en: My 10-year-old daughter was doing a class on how to evaluate good source information from search.

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think they're actually teaching this.

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, that was not a class when I was in school, obviously.

speaker: Unknown
en: But I think that kind of education going back into elementary school tells you that somebody coming out as a new grad probably had some of that kind of experience very early on.

en: So when you say, oh, they have four years of college experience, their education experience is entirely different.

speaker: Unknown
en: And you only know that by really building an understanding to question things.
